scope: Every source road candidate from every retained source-building road-envelope conflict, including restricted physical streets and mapped covered ways. Raw broad-phase candidates are not narrow-phase collisions.
widthEvidenceLimit: No reliable single uniform carriageway width is asserted from these context crops. This is an explicit remaining measurement gap, not measured-width parity. No road or building was moved, shrunk, deleted or fabricated to clear an estimate.
candidateEnvelopeCaveat: Estimated max-sided class envelopes and inferred sidewalk widths only find candidates. They are not independent pavement measurements and may overreach an asymmetric street or a separated level.
